gloss: intravenous infusion; IV drip; infusion fluid

definitions.gloss: intravenous infusion; IV drip; infusion fluid
definitions.explanation: The medical procedure of administering large volumes of fluid (saline, glucose, electrolytes, nutrients, or medication) into a patient's vein over a sustained period, or the fluid itself that is administered. Used to correct dehydration, restore electrolyte balance, deliver drugs, or provide nutrition to patients who cannot eat or drink.

examples.japanese: {患者|かんじゃ}に{輸液|ゆえき}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: We started an IV infusion on the patient.

examples.japanese: {脱水|だっすい}{症状|しょうじょう}があったので{輸液|ゆえき}{治療|ちりょう}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I had dehydration symptoms, so I received IV therapy.

examples.japanese: {食事|しょくじ}が{取|と}れない{間|あいだ}は、{栄養|えいよう}を{輸液|ゆえき}で{補|おぎな}う{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: While the patient cannot eat, nutrition has to be supplemented through IV infusion.

examples.japanese: {術後|じゅつご}{管理|かんり}では、{輸液|ゆえき}の{種類|しゅるい}と{速度|そくど}を{患者|かんじゃ}の{状態|じょうたい}に{合|あ}わせて{細|こま}かく{調整|ちょうせい}する。
examples.english: In postoperative care, the type and rate of IV infusion are finely adjusted to match the patient's condition.

notes:
Composed of {輸|ゆ} (to transport; to convey, as in {輸送|ゆそう} 'transport') and {液|えき} (liquid). Literally 'transported liquid,' the term covers both the act of infusion and the bagged solution itself.

USAGE:
A technical medical term used by doctors, nurses, pharmacists, and in patient charts. The everyday word a patient is more likely to use is {点滴|てんてき} (drip), which refers to the same procedure from the patient's point of view. {輸液|ゆえき} is preferred when discussing the formulation, volume, or rate ({輸液|ゆえき}{速度|そくど} 'infusion rate'), while {点滴|てんてき} is preferred when describing the bedside experience. Distinct from {輸血|ゆけつ}, which is the transfusion of blood specifically.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {輸液|ゆえき}を{行|おこな}う: to perform an infusion
- {輸液|ゆえき}{療法|りょうほう}: infusion therapy
- {輸液|ゆえき}ポンプ: infusion pump
- {維持|いじ}{輸液|ゆえき}: maintenance infusion (to maintain fluid balance)
- {高|こう}カロリー{輸液|ゆえき}: high-calorie (parenteral) nutrition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {点滴|てんてき}: IV drip — the everyday word; same procedure, less technical
- {輸血|ゆけつ}: blood transfusion — infusion of blood specifically, not general fluid
- {注射|ちゅうしゃ}: injection — a one-time push of medication, much smaller volume than {輸液|ゆえき}
- {生理食塩水|せいりしょくえんすい}: physiological saline — the most common type of IV fluid
